content:
Hi, I'm Rohan. I build market-making systems.

Areas I've been exploring semi-formally over the past 8 years include energy based models, model composition, symbolic systems, analytic number theory.

Using Claude + Aristotle (Harmonic's automated prover) extensively over the last couple of years has allowed me to refine some semi-formal ideas toward (auto)formalisation.

I'd like to engage with this community from the PoV of an outsider to academia / almost a student. I'll be sharing some of my work soon.
